title: Polish 2/7: Curated crate-root API surface + crate-level docs in lib.rs
description:
### Summary
Make `use swisseph::{Ephemeris, Body, CalcFlags, ...}` sufficient for all mainline usage: audit and complete the crate-root re-exports, and write the crate-level rustdoc (overview + quickstart doctest) in lib.rs. DESIGN DECISIONS ALREADY MADE — do not revisit: NO builder pattern (architecture invariant: construction via `EphemerisConfig` + `Default`); NO `compat` module with C names (C-name discoverability is handled by `#[doc(alias)]` attributes added in the Polish-3 doc sweep, plus a mapping table in the README task).

### Files
- `src/lib.rs` — crate docs (`//!`), expanded re-exports
- possibly `src/types.rs` / module files — visibility fixes only if the audit finds a public-signature type that isn't `pub` at its path (unlikely)

### Implementation steps
1. **Audit rule**: every type appearing in (a) a `pub fn` signature on `Ephemeris` (src/context.rs — there are ~50 methods), (b) a public field of an already re-exported struct, or (c) a `pub fn` signature in the application modules' free functions that users realistically call (houses::house_pos path goes through Ephemeris; math/date free functions count) MUST be importable from the crate root.
2. Known missing from lib.rs today — re-export at minimum: `types::{AstroModels, PrecessionModel, NutationModel, DeltaTModel, SiderealTimeModel, BiasModel, JplHorMode, JplHoraMode}`, `azalt::{RefracDir, AzAltDir, HorDir}` (and any refraction result struct), `heliacal::HeliacalEventType`, `flags::{SiderealBits, SplitDegFlags}` (confirm exact names/locations via grep). Complete the list from the step-1 audit — do not treat this enumeration as exhaustive.
3. **Crate-level docs** at the top of lib.rs: what the crate is (pure-Rust stateless port of the Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03), 10-line quickstart as a compiled doctest (Moshier backend, no data files: build default `EphemerisConfig`, `Ephemeris::new`, `calc_ut` the Sun, print longitude), a short section on the stateless design (config immutable after construction, `&self` everywhere, `Send + Sync`, per-call `*_with_config` overrides), and a module guide: one line per public module distinguishing the primary API (`context`/`Ephemeris`) from domain modules (houses, eclipse, heliacal, ...) and low-level internals (moshier, sweph_file, jpl, precession, nutation — "exposed for tests and advanced use; prefer `Ephemeris` methods").
4. Keep the re-export blocks grouped and alphabetized as they are now (lib.rs lines 34–54 pattern). If Polish-1 (feature flags) already landed, respect its cfg attributes on `pub mod sweph_file`/`pub mod jpl`; the quickstart doctest must compile with `--no-default-features` too (Moshier-only — it will, if it only uses default config).

### C reference
None.

### Golden tests
None — API surface only. Doctest is the verification.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --doc` passes (quickstart doctest runs)
- `cargo test` passes (no regressions)
- A scratch file importing every audited type via `use swisseph::{...}` compiles (do this as a doctest or `tests/api_surface.rs` with a single `#[test] fn imports_compile() {}` — prefer the test file so it's permanent)
- `cargo doc --no-deps` builds without warnings

### Escape hatch
If the audit finds a type that can't be cleanly re-exported (name collision between modules, or a type that arguably shouldn't be public), STOP and report the specific type and the collision rather than renaming public items on your own judgment.
execution_record: Audited all pub fn signatures on Ephemeris (~50 methods), all public fields of re-exported structs (EphemerisConfig, AstroModels), and public free functions in application modules (azalt, math, date, format). Found 16 missing re-exports: HeliacalFlags, HeliacalEventType, AzAltDir, HorDir, RefracDir, SplitDegFlags, SiderealBits, AstroModels, PrecessionModel, NutationModel, DeltaTModel, SiderealTimeModel, BiasModel, JplHorMode, JplHoraMode, FictitiousBody. NodeBits was defined but unused in any public surface — skipped. Wrote crate-level docs with quickstart doctest, stateless design section, module guide table. Fixed one `format` module link ambiguity (mod@format). Created tests/api_surface.rs as permanent compilation test. All verification passed: cargo test (178 tests), cargo test --doc, cargo test --no-default-features, cargo doc --no-deps (0 new warnings).

Codex review: approve with notes (both findings fixed in 4c98b0a).

1. [medium] Docs overstated per-call overrides — mentioned `*_with_config` internal variants as user-facing. Fixed: clarified only ephemeris source is per-call overridable via CalcFlags.
2. [medium] Module guide omitted `constants`, `calc`, `jpl`, `sweph_file`. Fixed: added rows with feature-gate notes for the file backends.

document the settled API surface, not a moving one
README quickstart mirrors the settled crate-root surface + lib.rs doctest
